source.title: CodeCharge Studio 1.0 Manual (beta-era)
source.distribution: User-supplied reference. Keep PDF, extracted text, screenshots and generated HTML local; only this authored index and conversion script are versioned.

sections.title: Workspace and selection
sections.interpretation: Explorer, document and contextual properties work together; inspect the selected page, form or control.

sections.title: Project setup, connections and security
sections.interpretation: Project-wide configuration is separate from page and form editing. Connection setup targets a database; security maps a login source.

sections.title: Form data sources and query designer
sections.interpretation: The form Data Source property opens a focused editor with tables, joins, parameters, data review and SQL inspection.

sections.title: Core form vocabulary
sections.interpretation: Pages contain Grid, Record, Search and Login forms. A form is a logical page component, not necessarily an HTML form element.

sections.title: Power and Page wizards
sections.interpretation: Wizards are bounded creation workflows. The Power Wizard starts from New Project and can build multiple pages.

sections.title: Grid wizard
sections.interpretation: Choose a connection, source and fields, then configure optional search, sorting, navigation and presentation.

sections.title: Record wizard
sections.interpretation: Configure record fields, operations and presentation; finish with an editable form.

sections.title: Search wizard
sections.interpretation: A search form supplies parameters to a grid or record form.

sections.title: Authentication wizard
sections.interpretation: Login is a focused form creation workflow tied to project security settings.

sections.title: Grid and Record wizard
sections.interpretation: The wizard constructs linked grid/record forms, including selected fields, the link field, optional search and allowed write operations.

sections.title: Object properties
sections.interpretation: Properties belong to selected objects; distinguish physical database metadata, form data binding, control settings and HTML formatting.

sections.title: Design, HTML, Code, Preview and Live Page
sections.interpretation: All modes address the same page. Preview is static; Live Page executes the generated app. Code ownership and regeneration need deliberate modern guarantees.

sections.title: Client event actions
sections.interpretation: Events and reusable actions extend objects; retain focus and validation needs without exposing every advanced feature at once.
